; reTaskable — "Send to reTaskable" capture hook for the handwriting lasso menu.
; xochitl 3.27 (reMarkable Paper Pro, 5.6.75 chiappa). xovi + qmldiff extension.
; SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
;
; Adds a button to the handwriting selection menu (SceneSelectionHandler's ?#tools:
; cut / copy / convert-to-text / delete) that captures the lassoed strokes as a
; CalDAV to-do WITHOUT altering the note. On tap it clones the selected items and
; runs cloud handwriting recognition (the same MyScript path "Convert to text"
; uses), reads the recognized text, and writes an intake JSON the reTaskable
; backend drains (M13 spool) into an anchored to-do that remembers its source page.
;
; Three coordinated patches, mirroring how the stock convert-to-text flow is wired:
;   A  SceneSelectionHandler.qml — the menu button + a `sendToReTaskable` signal
;   B  DeviceSceneView.qml       — wire the signal to a NON-DESTRUCTIVE convert-on-clone
;   C  HwcSelection.qml          — recognize (no insert) and write the intake JSON
;
; Published HASHED for xochitl 3.27 (qmldiff hashtab tokens, not symbol names). To
; read or edit: `qmldiff hash-diffs <device-hashtab> retaskableSend.qmd -r` unhashes
; it in place; edit the readable form, then re-hash (same command without -r) before
; committing. The device hashtab is at
; /home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/hashtab. See docs/m14-tooling/.

; --- A: handwriting-menu button + signal -------------------------------------
AFFECT [[3197972396468700595]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[10742505294233322867]]
		LOCATE BEFORE [[197082485]]
		INSERT { signal sendToReTaskable }
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE ?#[[214642769434]]
		LOCATE BEFORE [[425121728314878811.16765000136167945189.7081261925573]]#[[3012293087768835154]]
		INSERT {
			~&425121728314878811&~.~&16765000136167945189&~.~&7081261925573&~ {
				~&5972374&~: sendToReTaskableButton
				~&481641799955318521&~: ~&5971598&~.~&233696851602406&~
				~&6504337259&~: ~&214642769434&~.~&6504337259&~
				~&8399601734642709923&~: ~&"16588797428236211658&~
				~&254542236275632405&~: ~&10742505294233322867&~.sendToReTaskable()
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; --- B: wire the signal to a non-destructive convert-on-clone ----------------
AFFECT [[11806562588218124596]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[18399528329672988301]]
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			onSendToReTaskable: {
				~&6504254477&~.~&7282468819357443632&~(function () {
					~&11077763042784530127&~.sendToReTaskableFrom(~&8399340108982949229&~.~&5308518110917893541&~(~&8399340108982949229&~.~&15752433948179392809&~, ~&6504254477&~.~&15777890623490054006&~));
					~&6504254477&~.~&12148339614529610933&~();
				});
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; --- C: recognize (no insert) and write the M13 intake JSON ------------------
AFFECT [[15977735761668523171]]
	TRAVERSE ?#[[6504254477]]
		LOCATE BEFORE [[233724020120234]]
		INSERT {
			property ~&6503679477&~ sendingToReTaskable: ~&214625660372&~
			function sendToReTaskableFrom(~&214629893131&~) {
				sendingToReTaskable = ~&6504329801&~;
				~&8398536573969953217&~.~&15319355904852707254&~(~&214629893131&~, ~&7712198086779994&~.~&5671208228825160146&~);
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
	TRAVERSE ?#[[742117811095419965]]
		REBUILD [[12940955005542131354]]
			LOCATE AFTER STREAM / { /
			INSERT {
				~&5972376&~ (sendingToReTaskable) {
					~&5972376&~ (!~&7713012755563699&~) { ~&7083121450889&~; }
					~&197102514&~ rtText = ~&3875029581909304837&~.plainText.replace(/\n/g, ~&"180905&~).~&6504329413&~();
					~&197102514&~ rtPage = ~&6504254477&~.~&477346483278306569&~;
					~&197102514&~ rtPayload = ~&6502785411&~.~&254548178208422824&~({
						~&233744916906391&~: rtText,
						source_doc_uuid: ~&6504254477&~.~&7712934851008712&~.~&5972374&~,
						source_page_key: "idx:" + rtPage,
						source_label: "reMarkable note · p." + (rtPage + 1),
						captured_at:  new  ~&6502586279&~().toISOString()
					});
					~&197102514&~ rtReq =  new  XMLHttpRequest();
					rtReq.~&6504147419&~("PUT", "file:///home/root/.local/share/retaskable/intake/cap_" + ~&6502586279&~.now() + ".json");
					rtReq.~&6504279475&~(rtPayload);
					sendingToReTaskable = ~&214625660372&~;
					~&7083121450889&~;
				}
			}
		END REBUILD
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
